description:
[Merchant] Create up to 50 POIs in a single **atomic** call - the tool for rolling out a terminal estate.

**Endpoint:** POST /poi/batch -> 201 Created, returning `{ created, pois: [...] }`

**Atomic means all or nothing.** Either every entry is created or none is. That is the reason to
prefer this over a loop of `payware_poi_create`: a loop that fails on entry 27 leaves 26 POIs behind
with nothing recording where it stopped, and re-running it duplicates them.

**A POI belongs to a shop, and a shop belongs to a merchant.** `shopCode` is required - use
`payware_shops_list` to find one rather than guessing. Banks do not own POIs; a financial-institution
principal gets 403 on every POI endpoint, not an empty result.

**`ttlSeconds` is the price-session TTL, not the POI's lifetime.** It bounds how long a price set on
this POI stays claimable before the POI returns to IDLE. Range 60-600 seconds; the server
defaults it to 300.

**Defaults and overrides.** `shopCode`, `ttlSeconds` and `callbackUrl` at the top level apply to
every entry. An entry may override `name`, `ttlSeconds` and `callbackUrl` for itself. `shopCode` is
top-level only - one batch builds one shop.

**Limits:** 1 to 50 entries. An empty list is `ERR_BATCH_EMPTY`; more than 50 is
`ERR_BATCH_TOO_LARGE`. Both are refused locally before the request is sent. For a larger rollout,
split it into batches of 50 - each batch is atomic on its own, so record which batches succeeded.

callbackUrl.description: Default HTTPS callback URL for every POI in the batch.

partnerId.description: Partner ID from the payware dashboard. Uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

pois.description: The POIs to create. Each entry may set name, ttlSeconds and callbackUrl; anything omitted falls back to the top-level value. An entry may be an empty object, which creates an unnamed POI with the batch defaults.

callbackUrl.description: Overrides the batch callbackUrl for this POI.

ttlSeconds.description: Overrides the batch ttlSeconds for this POI.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for JWT signing. Uses the environment-specific key as default.

shopCode.description: Code of the shop every POI in this batch belongs to. Required, top-level only. Find one with payware_shops_list.

ttlSeconds.description: Default price-session TTL for every POI in the batch. Server default 300.

name: payware_poi_create_batch
